fssai_phase1_rules.description: Simplified high-priority rules for Phase-1 claim verification system

high_protein.condition: Protein content must be >= 20% of RDA per 100g (solids) or per 100ml (liquids)
high_protein.action: Compare declared protein value against current ICMR-NIN RDA. Flag if below threshold.

source_of_protein.condition: Protein content must be >= 10% of RDA per 100g or 100ml
source_of_protein.action: Flag if protein is below 10% of RDA

sugar_free.condition: Total sugars <= 0.5 g per 100g (solids) or per 100ml (liquids)
sugar_free.action: Check total sugars value in nutrition panel. Flag if above 0.5 g

low_sugar.condition: Total sugars <= 5 g per 100g (solids) or <= 2.5 g per 100ml (liquids)
low_sugar.action: Flag if sugars exceed the limit

conditions: No sucrose, glucose, fructose, honey, molasses, corn syrup, malt extract added
No sugar-containing ingredients used (jams, sweetened chocolate, dried fruit paste, date paste, fruit concentrates used for sweetening, etc.)
If naturally occurring sugars are present → label must declare 'CONTAINS NATURALLY OCCURRING SUGARS'
no_added_sugar.action: Scan ingredients list carefully. Flag if any form of added or substitute sugar is found. Also check for missing mandatory disclaimer.

high_fibre.condition: Dietary fibre >= 6 g per 100g (solids) or >= 3 g per 100ml (liquids)
high_fibre.action: Flag if fibre content is below threshold

source_of_fibre.condition: Dietary fibre >= 3 g per 100g (solids) or >= 1.5 g per 100ml (liquids)

low_fat.condition: Fat <= 3 g per 100g (solids) or <= 1.5 g per 100ml (liquids)

prohibited_immediate_flag.action: Immediately flag as high-risk or prohibited unless clear FSSAI approval exists
